title: [Kev 6] kev-serve: /v1/systemone + /v1/models + refusals
body:
Part of #9337.

## What to pull over

The serving surface, TypeSafe-contract compatible like `kev/serve.py`:

- `POST /v1/systemone`: body `{state, model, questions}` → `{model, answers, usage, latency_ms}` — answers shaped exactly like `crates/jev` decodes them.
- `GET /v1/models`: model id, base, artifact digests, `question_types`, `max_options`, context bounds.
- Typed refusals: `model_unknown`, `unsupported_question_type`, `too_many_options`, `branch_too_long`, `invalid_request` (422-class).
- `kev-serve` binary in `crates/kev` (axum), `--run <artifact-dir> --port` flags.

## Acceptance

- `cargo run -p kev --bin kev-serve -- --run <dir>` serves answers through the mesh-compatible contract on this machine.
- A `crates/jev` client with `base_url` pointed at it round-trips noul/choice/score unmodified.
- Refusal cases return typed errors, not 500s.
